name: Saved views and predictions
summary: Named filter views on the overview, trends, alerts and schedule pages, the prediction chart that projects completion from planned, recent, required and average rates, and further overview summaries asked for in PRDs.

roles.note: Saved-view routes check a permission string, manage-saved-views, that is not in the seed catalog, so which roles hold it can't be read from the seed. A view can be changed or deleted only by its owner.

nfr.statement: Time to compute the prediction chart for one stage across the selected locations.
nfr.open_question: What load time is acceptable for predictions on a large project, given they are computed on request?

requirements.title: Saved views belong to their owner and have unique names
requirements.statement: A user saves the current filters of the overview, trends, alerts or schedule page as a named view for that project. Names are trimmed, must not be empty and must be unique per user, project and page. Only the owner can rename, change or delete a view. Each page also has a built-in default view that can't be changed or deleted, only made or unmade the default.
requirements.rationale: Implements the overview PRD's save, retrieve, rename and delete of filtered views (FR-002) and the alerts V1 saved views (FR-004). Sharing a view is SHARE-FEAT-03.

requirements.title: One default view per page, chosen automatically on trends
requirements.statement: Each user has at most one default view per project and page; making a view the default unsets the previous one, and with no default of their own the built-in view is the default. On trends only, a user's first view becomes the default automatically, they can't unset the default on their only view, and deleting the default passes it to their earliest remaining view.

requirements.title: Predictions project completion from four rates
requirements.statement: For one stage, the prediction compares four rates per working week: planned (takeoff over the scheduled duration), recent (work in the last 28 days), required (remaining work over working days left to the scheduled end, zero once the latest capture is past that end) and average (work since the scheduled start). Each non-zero rate gives an estimated completion date; estimates more than a year out are flagged instead of dated, and the chart projects weekly totals up to one year after the latest capture.
requirements.rationale: Extends the potential-delay forecast (PROG-REQ-031), which uses the average rate only. No required rate is given past the schedule end, as prediction-enhancements.md FR-004 asks.

requirements.title: Predictions are off by default and limited to one stage
requirements.statement: Predictions start switched off, including in the built-in trends view. The switch appears only in ML-method projects; it is disabled when takeoff is turned off (with a hint to enable it) or the stage is complete, and choosing more than one stage turns predictions off. The PRD says predictions should be on by default.

dispute.summary: prediction-enhancements.md FR-001 and AC-001 say predictions are enabled by default. The web app and the built-in trends view default them off, and also restrict them to ML-method projects, which the PRD does not mention.

requirements.title: Productivity under different working conditions
requirements.statement: Users enter changes to working conditions and see how productivity would change, and the same insights are available through an API. Where an "efficiency improvement" could mean more output or less time, the system says which.
requirements.rationale: PRD only. Alerts already carry suggestion fields (recent and required rate per day, a work rate and a manpower figure), but no user-defined work-condition model was found. Detailed manpower estimation is out of scope in the PRD.

requirements.title: Overview highlights issues and summarises portfolio status
requirements.statement: The overview highlights cells with issues by predefined criteria, with tooltips explaining them and links to where they can be fixed. Summary cards show schedule adherence, active projects and user activity, and the project performance card can be filtered and sorted, with details behind its status numbers and comment icons.
requirements.rationale: PRD only; grouped from three overview enhancement PRDs. The issue criteria aren't defined. Schedule adherence itself is SCHD-REQ-013.
